habitat: 키 큰 풀이 자란 초지, 관목림, 풀로 덮인 개활지, 산허리와 구릉의 숲

months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이며, 대부분 1910~1970년대 북부 지방과 서울·경기 지역의 표본 기록이다.

summary: 키 큰 풀이 자란 초지와 관목림, 풀로 덮인 트인 땅, 산허리나 구릉의 숲에 사는 새로, 꼬리 길이가 8~10.5cm로 날개 길이 6~6.5cm보다 길다. 한국 북부와 중국 북부·북동부에서 번식하고, 한국 중부 이남에서 겨울을 난다. 숲속 땅 위에 둥지를 지어 한배에 알 5개를 낳으며, 번식을 마친 겨울에는 작은 무리를 짓는다. 곤충과 씨앗, 열매를 먹는다.

art.subject: Beijing Babbler (Rhopophilus pekinensis), adult in winter (sexes alike): crown, nape and upperparts greyish brown, streaked dark brown everywhere except the plain rump and uppertail coverts; pale greyish-white supercilium; a thin but distinct black malar stripe running from the base of the lower mandible down the side of the throat; white throat; breast and belly whitish, the lower flanks and vent washed buff, with neat rufous-chestnut streaks along the flanks. Very long, graduated tail: central feathers greyish brown like the back, outer feathers blackish brown with greyish-white tips. Bill short, pale horn to yellowish with a darker upper ridge; iris pale whitish to pale yellowish; legs pinkish.
art.pose: perched on a shrub stem in tall grass, long tail hanging, side view
art.scene: Korean winter hillside with tall dry grass and scattered shrubs; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a grass stem: greyish-brown upperparts streaked dark brown, thin black malar stripe below the cheek, pale iris, pale horn bill, white throat and whitish underparts with rufous-brown flank streaks, pinkish legs, very long graduated tail hanging down
adult, tail from above with feathers spread: greyish-brown central feathers, blackish-brown outer feathers with greyish-white tips, unstreaked rump and uppertail coverts
art.build: Small, slim, long-tailed bird with a sparrow-sized body; the tail alone is longer than the wing and makes up about half the total length. Rounded head with no crest; the crown feathers lie flat. Short neck. Bill short, fairly slender and pointed, with a gently curved upper ridge, shorter than the head. Legs pinkish, sturdy, of medium length. Wings short and rounded, reaching only the base of the tail. Tail strongly graduated, usually hanging down or held in line with the body. Moves low through tall grass and bushes, in small flocks in winter.
avoid: Do not make the upperparts plain; crown, back and wing coverts are clearly streaked dark brown.
Do not paint it like a Long-tailed Tit (round body, tiny bill, pink-and-black plumage) or a parrotbill (stubby deep bill).
Do not add wing bars, a rufous crown or streaks across the centre of the breast; the rufous streaks are on the flanks only.
Do not paint a dark brown eye or a black bill; the iris is pale whitish to yellowish and the bill pale horn.
